resources.string: Finds your Android device, installs Android Screen Timer, and helps enable protection — no separate ADB app required.
On the target device, enable Developer options and wireless or network debugging once. Android will require the owner to approve the connection.
Steps for a TV, tablet, or phone
The phone and target device must use the same Wi‑Fi network. Discovery stays inside your local network.
Try maximum uninstall protection (new/reset device without accounts only)
Turn off wireless debugging after successful installation
Ready to scan. No data is sent to the internet.
No devices found. Check Wi‑Fi and debugging, or enter the IP and port manually.
Selected: %1$s. Enter a code if it is not paired yet; otherwise tap Connect.
Pairing with %1$s… Keep the code dialog open on the target device.
Connecting to %1$s:%2$d… Approve the key on the target device if asked.
Done. Android Screen Timer is installed and open on the target device.%1$s
Pairing complete. Tap “Find devices” if the connection port has not appeared yet.
Enter the IP, pairing port, and a fresh 6-digit code.
Wait for the current operation to finish.
Device Owner gives maximum uninstall protection, but Android permits it only on a new or reset device with no accounts or work profiles. If Android rejects it, the normal installation will continue.

TV / GOOGLE TV
1. Settings → System or Device preferences → About.
2. Press “Build”, “Build number”, or “Android TV OS build” seven times.
3. Go back → Developer options.
4. Android TV 13+: enable Wireless debugging, open it, and select “Pair using pairing code”.
5. If you see “Network debugging”, “ADB debugging”, or “Debug over network”, enable it and use the displayed IP/port; port 5555 is common.

PHONE / TABLET
1. Settings → About phone/tablet → press “Build number” seven times.
2. System → Developer options → Wireless debugging.
3. Open “Pair using pairing code”.

IMPORTANT
• USB debugging is for a cable connection. Wi‑Fi requires the separate wireless/network debugging switch.
• On an older device without network debugging, a phone cannot enable ADB by itself. Install the APK directly from USB storage/a browser, or enable ADB over the network once from a computer.
• Menu names vary slightly across Samsung, Xiaomi, TCL, Haier, Sony, and other manufacturers.
\n\nScreen control could not be enabled automatically. Open Accessibility on the target device and enable Android Screen Timer manually.
\nDevice Owner was not assigned: the device is already set up or the firmware rejected it.
\nWireless debugging was turned off for safety.
\nTurn off network/wireless debugging on the target device manually.
